This '''technician''' operated a special [[Cybernetics/Legends|cybernetic]] [[Cybernetic chamber|chamber]] aboard the [[Super Star Destroyer/Legends|Super Star Destroyer]] [[Executor/Legends|''Executor'']] in early [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]]. [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] attempted to use the machine, which enabled him to reach across [[Realspace/Legends|space]] with [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] through a cybernetic link, to discover the location of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebels']] [[Alliance High Command/Legends|secret base]] following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]].
